review.why: This reads as a consumer and business platform, not a generic SaaS template. Specific work, supplied creative, literal review states and conditional pay carry the explanation; pricing arrives after the product workflows. The source-to-commitment relationship survives outside the miniature screenshots through readable native terms. Navigation, audience entry points and inspection controls remain visible. The business frames show discovery, review and content operations without collapsing approval into publication. There is no visible invented payout, installed-ad claim or automatic success sequence. The different page layout and repeated frames are appropriate to the explicitly unrolled production presentation, not evidence of missing sticky stages.
review.verdict: Yes—Frame Shift has transferred convincingly to the desktop public site, and the visible real-product functionality and financial semantics remain intact.
